rows.story_lead: Olivia writes and illustrates her own book to make her uncle laugh. When the pages scatter across town, delivery by delivery, everyone ends up helping gather and share it.
rows.resolution: The happiness of the gift is the story from start to finish, and there is no struggle to handle; the row lets the laughter land, Uncle Theo's included.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: the handmade book, Delivery Delores carrying the lost pages unknowingly, the town reading it aloud together, Uncle Theo laughing at the silly story, Cooper making a book for Jack)'; confidence high. Custom situation per dev set: doing something kind for someone you love. Coping left empty with reason per dev set. Topics anchored to the book-making story.

rows.segment_title: Jack and the Fur-Ever Home Finders
rows.story_lead: Sonia cares for the animals at an adoption fair and wants every pet to find a home, so Jack and the neighbors join her as the Fur-Ever Home Finders. A no-pets apartment gets answered with hand-drawn pet portraits.
rows.resolution: This one is a helping story with no feeling to work through, and the row leaves it there, happy and adopted down to the last unclaimed puppy, named Happy.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: the adoption fair, a would-be adopter blocked by a no-pets apartment answered with hand-drawn pet portraits, Jack adopting the last unclaimed puppy and naming him Happy)'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set. Content consideration carried: adoption-fair theme, handled gently.

rows.story_lead: Cooper's giant chalk game, Hop-o-Rama, is washed away by water, and he says exactly how sad that feels. With Jack's encouragement, the town rebuilds it even bigger, all the way to the café.
rows.resolution: The sadness of the ruined game gets named first and tried again second, and the chalk rainbow delivery plus the tick-tac-thank-you square end it in cheering.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: the Hop-o-Rama squares stretching to the café, the ruined game and the naming of how sad that feels, the chalk rainbow delivery, the tick-tac-thank-you square, the town finishing and cheering)'; confidence high. Topics anchored to the giant game itself.

rows.story_lead: Chef hurts his arm and cannot cook, so Jack and the neighbors step in to keep the Friday Feast pizza tradition alive. An accidental vegetable pizza becomes the surprise hit.
rows.resolution: The disappointment of the fallen pizza gets reframed, the clover shape and the broccolizza everyone ends up loving, and the shared slice is where the happiness comes from.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: Chef's sling, Jack kneading dough for the first time, the neighbors each pitching in a job, the fallen pizza and the shared disappointment, the clover shape and the broccolizza everyone ends up loving)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: visible arm injury in a sling, played lightly. Topics anchored to the pizza story.

rows.story_lead: Mr. Prickles misses the garden at his old home after moving, and he says so. Jack and the friends plant him a new garden full of surprises until the new house finally feels like home.
rows.resolution: The homesickness gets asked for comfort, Jack naming his own sad days and how a friend helps, and tomatoes, carrots and a gnome named Terry make the new place home.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: the confession that moving was hard and the old garden is missed, Jack naming his own sad days and how a friend helps, the planted tomatoes and carrots, the garden gnome named Terry, the new friends making it a home)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: moving-house and missing-home theme.

rows.story_lead: Cooper hands out paper hearts to brighten everyone's day and runs out, and he learns that his caring itself was the real gift. Meanwhile Bebe's broken guitar is soothed by making music with your heart.
rows.resolution: The sad of the empty hands and the broken guitar ends in reframing, the hearts matter less than the person giving them, and drumming the music in her heart is what helps Bebe feel better.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: Cooper running out of hearts, the paper hearts versus the person giving them, friends sitting with Bebe and her broken guitar, drumming the music in her heart, playing music helping her feel better)'; confidence high. rows.resolution: The worry of the unknown ride ends in naming the feeling, the practice run and the song about new things feeling nervous, and the brave shows up when she picks her own seat.

rows.story_lead: Olivia is too scared of the spooky jack-o'-lantern faces to trick-or-treat, and she names it. Jack leads the way as her trick-or-treating buddy, and the friends turn Halloween into something Hallo-wonderful instead.
rows.resolution: The scare gets asking for comfort, the validation that it is okay to be scared and the buddy plan. The decorations get reframed as friendly Hallo-winks, and the trick-or-treat succeeds.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: Olivia naming that the spooky faces scare her, the validation that it is okay to be scared, the buddy plan, the Queen Mermaidia costume, the reframing of decorations as friendly Hallo-winks, the successful trick-or-treat)'; confidence high. Content considerations carried: mild spooky imagery; Cooper's food allergies are mentioned with care.

rows.story_lead: Bebe's big concert is threatened when hiccups take over her voice, and she says they feel like they will never go away. Her friends and Chef turn the hiccups into the beat of her song.
rows.resolution: The frustration and the sadness of a voice that won't cooperate get reframed, the hiccups become the rhythm, and the concert is sung anyway.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: the hiccups interrupting every attempt, Bebe saying they feel like they will never go away, the friends sharing what they love about her singing, Chef's strawberry-noodle pancakes, the hiccups becoming the rhythm, the concert sung anyway)'; confidence high. rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (SubtitleCat SRT, content verified against catalog: the clock hand barely moving, Peyton saying she is so impatient, the doing-nothing experiment and how it helps a little, the funny faces and the decorated sandwich, waiting being better together, Lindsay the Great's juggling show as the payoff)'; confidence high.
